@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-shel.reason: Shell settings card: the executor's command timeout and per-stream output cap (shell namespace). The card mount exists since #278, but the Edge's bash is its own: createEdgeBashTool (agent.ts) forwards only a per-call timeoutMs, the timeout default and ceiling come from DSH_EDGE_DEFAULT/MAX_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS (workspace.ts), and the Direct output cap is the fixed EDGE_SHELL_OUTPUT_LIMIT_BYTES (direct-shell.ts). Restoring the card needs an Edge shell namespace that the timeout policy and both shell backends (Direct and the Isolated/container paths) read live.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-suba.reason: Subagent settings card: delegation depth and capacity (subagent namespace: maxDepth, maxActiveSubagents) and the models agents may choose (subagent-model-selection namespace) on one page. The card mount exists since #278, but session-store.ts mounts ToolSubagent with a fixed maxDepth of 1 that wins over a namespace value and without modelSelectionSettings (default false), and the Edge does not mount dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings. Restoring the card needs both namespaces served, the fixed depth replaced by the subagent namespace and committed to the running tool, ToolSubagent mounted with modelSelectionSettings: true, and the model-selection plugin mounted.

wikiOmit.agent-team: Experimental Agent Teams (dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team) are declined; subagents are covered on the Subagent page.
wikiOmit.browser-use: Drives a local Chromium process through experimental providers; Workers cannot run a browser engine.
wikiOmit.computer-use: Observes and operates the local desktop; a Worker has no desktop.
wikiOmit.extensions: Agent-defined Cordis packages installed and loaded at runtime; Workers cannot install or import packages at runtime, so the Edge composition is fixed at build time.
wikiOmit.office-to-pdf: Office conversion through a native LibreOffice build on the host.
wikiOmit.product-telemetry: Desktop product analytics over OTLP; the Edge excludes the client analytics plugin and mounts no exporter.
wikiOmit.ssh: Moves the filesystem and process world to a remote host over a deployment-owned OpenSSH connection; the Edge workspace is the Durable Object VFS with an optional Linux container.
wikiOmit.voice-input: Experimental speech-to-text with local SenseVoice inference on the host.
wikiOmit.webhook: External deliveries that create root Sessions are not offered; GitHub webhook review sessions are tracked in #180.
